Product scope

Select the coating around the converting process, not a generic eco label.

This page concerns coated base paper for downstream converters. Finished cups, bowls, containers and paper bags are not implied. Share the food application, forming or sealing process, print requirement and destination market before a grade is recommended.

Material: Paper with a water-based barrier coating; base paper, coating side and finished construction are confirmed for the intended application.

Applications

Uses to confirm before sampling

  • Base paper for paper cups
  • Base paper for paper bowls and food containers
  • Base paper for paper bags
  • Custom printing and forming trials

Buyer decision guide

Four checks before a quote becomes an order

Barrier target

Define food type, moisture, oil, contact time and temperature instead of assuming one coating fits every use.

Forming and sealing

Confirm equipment, forming method, sealing window and required bonding through a physical trial.

Print and converting

Review printing, slitting, custom roll width and the ±2 g/m² typical grammage tolerance against the downstream process.

End-of-life claims

Recyclability, repulpability and PFAS-related wording require separate evidence for the exact construction and market.

Evidence boundary

A tested 246 gsm double-side coated reference sample

Available 2025 test evidence covers a roll sample made from 230 g/m² base paper with 8 g/m² coating on each side, for a nominal total of 246 g/m² and a nominal width of 960 mm. The report states that the tested items passed under the listed Chinese standards.

Evidence itemWhat it supports
Tested constructionDouble-side coated roll; 230 + 8 + 8 g/m²; 960 mm nominal width
Referenced standardsGB 4806.8-2022, GB 4806.10-2016 and GB 4806.13-2023, plus the listed product standard
Tested-item coverageAppearance, absorption, grease and leakage resistance, sensory, migration and other listed items
Evidence boundaryApplies to the tested sample; other grammages and destination-market claims require separate review

Supplier and report-holder identities are handled confidentially during buyer document review. Public claims remain limited to the relevant product and tested scope.

Production & commercial terms

Typical tolerance, width, MOQ, lead time and samples

These are general planning figures for the two coated base-paper grades, not unconditional commitments. The written specification and quotation state the confirmed figures for each order.

Grammage tolerance

Typical grammage tolerance is ±2 g/m². The accepted tolerance for the specific grade is recorded in the approved specification and written quotation.

Roll width

Roll width can be customized to the converter's required dimension. The 960 mm and 975 mm widths in the available test reports are the nominal widths of those tested samples, not a limit on custom widths.

MOQ

MOQ generally starts at 5 tonnes for coated base paper. The confirmed quantity depends on the selected grade, customization, packaging and order structure and is stated in the written quotation.

Lead time

Lead time depends on the order quantity and production schedule. It is confirmed in the written quotation rather than published as a fixed number of days.

Sample route

A 200 m sample length can be provided in any requested specification. Confirm grammage, coating side, width and shipping arrangements before dispatch.

Written approval

The quotation and order should identify the approved product, grammage tolerance, dimensions, material or coating, print, packing, documents and delivery terms.

FAQ

Water-Based Coated Paper FAQ

Does this page supply finished paper cups or bowls?

No. The current offer is coated base paper for converting. Finished products require a separately confirmed scope.

What MOQ applies to water-based coated paper?

MOQ generally starts at 5 tonnes for coated base paper. The confirmed quantity depends on the selected grade, customization, packaging and order structure and is stated in the written quotation.

Can we specify a custom roll width and tolerance?

Yes. Roll width can be customized to the converter's required dimension. The 960 mm and 975 mm widths in the available test reports are the nominal widths of those tested samples, not a limit on custom widths. Typical grammage tolerance is ±2 g/m². The accepted tolerance for the specific grade is recorded in the approved specification and written quotation.

How is lead time determined?

Lead time depends on the order quantity and production schedule. It is confirmed in the written quotation rather than published as a fixed number of days.

Can we request a custom 200 m sample?

Yes. A 200 m sample length can be provided in any requested specification after the grammage, coating, width and shipment details are confirmed.

Does the test report prove recyclability or compostability?

No. The reviewed report supports only its tested sample and listed items. Recyclability, repulpability and compostability are separate evidence questions.
